title: Classic Egg Omelette
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_001","title":"Classic Egg Omelette","calories":"250-300","cuisine":"French","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A fluffy French-style omelette with a golden exterior and creamy center.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"egg","quantity":"4","unit":"pcs"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp"},{"name":"milk","quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","pink salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","cayenne pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Crack 4 eggs into a bowl and add 2 tablespoons of milk. Whisk vigorously for 30 seconds until light and frothy.","Place a non-stick pan over medium heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter. Let it melt and foam for about 1 minute.","Pour the egg mixture into the pan. Let it sit undisturbed for 30 seconds until the edges begin to set.","Using a spatula, gently push the cooked edges toward the center while tilting the pan. Repeat for 2-3 minutes.","When the top is still slightly moist but the bottom is golden, fold the omelette in half.","Slide onto a warm plate and season with salt and black pepper. Serve immediately."]}

title: Garlic Butter Pasta
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_002","title":"Garlic Butter Pasta","calories":"400-450","cuisine":"Italian","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Simple yet elegant pasta tossed in a rich garlic butter sauce.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"pasta","quantity":"250","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"4","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"3","unit":"tbsp"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","red pepper flakes"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil. Add 250g pasta and cook until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.","Peel and thinly slice 4 cloves of garlic. Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium-low heat.","Add the sliced garlic and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently, until light golden and fragrant.","Add 3 tablespoons butter and swirl until melted and combined with the garlic oil, about 1 minute.","Add the drained pasta. Toss vigorously for 1-2 minutes, adding reserved pasta water until the sauce coats the pasta evenly.","Season with salt and black pepper. Serve immediately."]}

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_003","title":"Chicken Stir-Fry","calories":"350-400","cuisine":"Asian","difficulty":"Medium","description":"Tender chicken pieces with colorful vegetables in a savory soy sauce glaze.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"chicken","quantity":"300","unit":"g"},{"name":"soy sauce","quantity":"3","unit":"tbsp"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"3","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"medium"},{"name":"bell pepper","quantity":"1","unit":"large"}],"spices":[{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","szechuan pepper"]},{"name":"garlic powder","alternatives":["onion powder","ginger powder"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Cut 300g chicken breast into thin strips. Season with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and black pepper. Marinate 5 minutes.","Dice the onion and bell pepper into 2cm pieces. Mince 3 garlic cloves.","Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok over high heat until smoking.","Add chicken strips in a single layer. Sear 2 minutes per side until golden. Remove and set aside.","Add onion and bell pepper. Stir-fry 3-4 minutes over high heat until slightly charred but crisp.","Add minced garlic, cook 30 seconds. Return chicken to wok.","Pour in remaining 2 tablespoons soy sauce and 2 tablespoons water. Toss 1-2 minutes until sauce thickens.","Serve immediately over steamed rice."]}

title: Tomato Rice Pilaf
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_004","title":"Tomato Rice Pilaf","calories":"300-350","cuisine":"Mediterranean","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Fragrant rice cooked with fresh tomatoes and aromatic spices.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"rice","quantity":"200","unit":"g"},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"2","unit":"medium"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"medium"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp"}],"spices":[{"name":"cumin","alternatives":["coriander","caraway"]},{"name":"paprika","alternatives":["smoked paprika","chili powder"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Rinse 200g rice under cold water 3 times. Soak in warm water for 10 minutes, then drain.","Dice the onion finely and chop 2 tomatoes into small cubes.","Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat.","Add onion and saute 3-4 minutes until translucent.","Add tomatoes, 1/2 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp paprika. Cook 3 minutes until tomatoes soften.","Add rice and stir 1 minute to coat each grain.","Pour in 400ml hot water and 1 tsp salt. Bring to boil, reduce to low. Cover and cook 18-20 minutes.","Rest covered 5 minutes. Fluff with fork and serve."]}

title: Banana Pancakes
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_005","title":"Banana Pancakes","calories":"350-400","cuisine":"American","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Fluffy golden pancakes studded with sweet mashed banana.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"banana","quantity":"2","unit":"medium"},{"name":"egg","quantity":"2","unit":"pcs"},{"name":"flour","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"milk","quantity":"120","unit":"ml"}],"spices":[{"name":"cinnamon","alternatives":["nutmeg","allspice"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Peel 2 bananas and mash in a bowl with a fork until mostly smooth.","Add 2 eggs and 120ml milk. Whisk until combined.","Add 150g flour, pinch of salt, 1/2 tsp cinnamon. Stir gently until just combined. Rest 3 minutes.","Heat non-stick pan over medium heat. Add 1/2 tbsp butter.","Pour 3 tablespoons batter per pancake. Cook 2-3 minutes until bubbles form on surface.","Flip and cook 1-2 minutes until golden brown.","Repeat with remaining batter. Serve with honey or maple syrup."]}

title: Creamy Mushroom Soup
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_006","title":"Creamy Mushroom Soup","calories":"200-250","cuisine":"French","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A velvety smooth mushroom soup with deep earthy flavors.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"mushroom","quantity":"300","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"medium"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"2","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"thyme","alternatives":["rosemary","oregano"]},{"name":"nutmeg","alternatives":["mace","allspice"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Clean and slice 300g mushrooms. Dice the onion finely. Mince 2 garlic cloves.","Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a pot over medium heat.","Add onion and cook 3-4 minutes until soft. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds.","Add mushrooms and cook 6-8 minutes until they release their liquid and turn golden.","Add 500ml water, 1/2 tsp thyme, pinch of nutmeg, salt and pepper. Simmer 10 minutes.","Blend with immersion blender until smooth. Adjust seasoning and serve hot."]}

title: Potato Wedges
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_007","title":"Crispy Potato Wedges","calories":"300-350","cuisine":"American","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Golden crispy potato wedges seasoned with garlic and herbs.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"potato","quantity":"4","unit":"medium"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"3","unit":"tbsp"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"3","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"paprika","alternatives":["smoked paprika","chili powder"]},{"name":"garlic powder","alternatives":["onion powder"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat oven to 220C. Wash 4 potatoes and cut each into 8 wedges.","Mince 3 garlic cloves. Toss wedges with 3 tbsp olive oil, garlic, 1 tsp paprika, salt and pepper.","Spread wedges in a single layer on a baking sheet, skin side down.","Bake 15 minutes, then flip and bake another 12-15 minutes until golden and crispy.","Remove from oven, let cool 2 minutes, and serve with your favorite dipping sauce."]}

title: Shakshuka
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_008","title":"Shakshuka","calories":"280-330","cuisine":"Middle Eastern","difficulty":"Medium","description":"Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"egg","quantity":"4","unit":"pcs"},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"4","unit":"medium"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"medium"},{"name":"bell pepper","quantity":"1","unit":"large"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"3","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"cumin","alternatives":["coriander","caraway"]},{"name":"paprika","alternatives":["smoked paprika","chili powder"]},{"name":"chili flakes","alternatives":["cayenne","hot paprika"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Dice onion, bell pepper, and tomatoes. Mince 3 garlic cloves.","Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a deep skillet over medium heat.","Saute onion and bell pepper 4-5 minutes until softened.","Add garlic, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp chili flakes. Cook 1 minute.","Add tomatoes, salt and pepper. Simmer 10-12 minutes until sauce thickens.","Make 4 wells in the sauce. Crack an egg into each well.","Cover and cook 5-7 minutes until egg whites are set but yolks are still runny.","Serve hot with crusty bread."]}

title: Fried Rice
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_009","title":"Quick Fried Rice","calories":"380-420","cuisine":"Asian","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Classic fried rice with egg and vegetables, ready in minutes.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"rice","quantity":"300","unit":"g"},{"name":"egg","quantity":"2","unit":"pcs"},{"name":"soy sauce","quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"2","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"small"}],"spices":[{"name":"white pepper","alternatives":["black pepper"]},{"name":"garlic powder","alternatives":["onion powder"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Use 300g day-old cooked rice (cold rice works best). Break up any clumps with your hands.","Dice onion finely. Mince 2 garlic cloves. Beat 2 eggs in a small bowl.","Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat until smoking.","Pour in beaten eggs. Scramble quickly for 30 seconds until just set. Break into small pieces and remove.","Add onion to the wok. Stir-fry 2 minutes. Add garlic, cook 30 seconds.","Add rice and stir-fry 3-4 minutes, pressing rice against wok to get slightly crispy.","Return eggs to wok. Add 2 tbsp soy sauce and pinch of white pepper. Toss 1 minute.","Serve immediately."]}

title: Caprese Salad
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_010","title":"Classic Caprese Salad","calories":"250-300","cuisine":"Italian","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Fresh tomatoes and mozzarella with olive oil - pure Italian simplicity.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"tomato","quantity":"3","unit":"large"},{"name":"mozzarella","quantity":"200","unit":"g"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["flaky sea salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Slice 3 large tomatoes into 1cm thick rounds.","Slice 200g fresh mozzarella into similar thickness.","Arrange alternating slices of tomato and mozzarella on a plate in an overlapping pattern.","Drizzle generously with 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil.","Season with flaky salt and freshly ground black pepper. Serve immediately."]}

title: Honey Garlic Chicken
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_011","title":"Honey Garlic Chicken","calories":"400-450","cuisine":"Asian","difficulty":"Medium","description":"Tender chicken thighs glazed in a sticky honey garlic sauce.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"chicken","quantity":"400","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"5","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"honey","quantity":"3","unit":"tbsp"},{"name":"soy sauce","quantity":"3","unit":"tbsp"}],"spices":[{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper"]},{"name":"garlic powder","alternatives":["onion powder"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Cut 400g chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.","Mince 5 garlic cloves. Mix 3 tbsp honey, 3 tbsp soy sauce, and 2 tbsp water in a bowl.","Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.","Sear chicken pieces 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown.","Add minced garlic, cook 30 seconds until fragrant.","Pour honey-soy mixture over chicken. Simmer 5-7 minutes, turning chicken occasionally, until sauce thickens and coats the chicken.","Serve over steamed rice."]}

title: Spinach and Egg Scramble
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_012","title":"Spinach and Egg Scramble","calories":"200-250","cuisine":"Mediterranean","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Soft scrambled eggs with wilted garlic spinach.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"egg","quantity":"4","unit":"pcs"},{"name":"spinach","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"2","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper"]},{"name":"nutmeg","alternatives":["mace"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Wash 150g spinach thoroughly and drain. Mince 2 garlic cloves.","Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a pan over medium heat.","Add garlic, cook 30 seconds. Add spinach, cook 2-3 minutes until wilted.","Beat 4 eggs with salt, pepper, and pinch of nutmeg.","Pour eggs over spinach. Stir gently with a spatula for 2-3 minutes until soft curds form.","Remove from heat while still slightly wet (they continue cooking). Serve immediately."]}

title: Lemon Butter Fish
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_013","title":"Lemon Butter Pan-Seared Fish","calories":"300-350","cuisine":"Mediterranean","difficulty":"Medium","description":"Delicate fish fillets in a bright lemon butter sauce.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"fish","quantity":"2","unit":"fillets"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"large"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"3","unit":"tbsp"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"2","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper"]},{"name":"paprika","alternatives":["cayenne"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Pat 2 fish fillets dry with paper towels. Season both sides with salt, pepper, and paprika.","Heat 1 tbsp butter and 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.","Place fish skin-side up. Cook 3-4 minutes without moving until golden crust forms.","Flip carefully. Cook another 2-3 minutes until fish flakes easily.","Remove fish. Add remaining 2 tbsp butter, minced garlic, and juice of 1 lemon to the pan.","Swirl 1-2 minutes until sauce is bubbly and fragrant. Pour over fish and serve."]}

title: Vegetable Curry
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_014","title":"Vegetable Curry","calories":"350-400","cuisine":"Indian","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A rich and creamy vegetable curry with aromatic spices.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"potato","quantity":"2","unit":"medium"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"large"},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"2","unit":"medium"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"3","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"coconut milk","quantity":"200","unit":"ml"}],"spices":[{"name":"turmeric","alternatives":["curry powder"]},{"name":"cumin","alternatives":["coriander"]},{"name":"garam masala","alternatives":["curry powder","allspice"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Peel and dice 2 potatoes into 2cm cubes. Dice onion. Chop 2 tomatoes. Mince 3 garlic cloves.","Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pot over medium heat. Add onion, cook 4-5 minutes until golden.","Add garlic, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp garam masala. Cook 1 minute until fragrant.","Add tomatoes and cook 3-4 minutes until they break down.","Add potatoes and 200ml coconut milk. Add 100ml water and salt.","Bring to boil, then simmer 20-25 minutes until potatoes are fork-tender.","Adjust seasoning and serve over steamed rice."]}

title: Bruschetta
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_015","title":"Classic Bruschetta","calories":"200-250","cuisine":"Italian","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Crispy toasted bread topped with fresh tomato and garlic.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"bread","quantity":"4","unit":"slices"},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"3","unit":"medium"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"2","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"3","unit":"tbsp"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Dice 3 tomatoes into small cubes. Mince 1 garlic clove and mix with tomatoes, 1 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper. Let sit 5 minutes.","Slice bread into 2cm thick slices. Brush both sides with remaining olive oil.","Toast bread in a hot pan or grill for 1-2 minutes per side until golden and crispy.","Rub one side of each toast with the remaining raw garlic clove.","Spoon the tomato mixture generously onto each toast. Serve immediately."]}

title: Beef Tacos
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_016","title":"Seasoned Beef Tacos","calories":"450-500","cuisine":"Mexican","difficulty":"Medium","description":"Flavorful seasoned ground beef in warm tortillas.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"beef","quantity":"300","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"medium"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"2","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"tortilla","quantity":"4","unit":"pcs"}],"spices":[{"name":"cumin","alternatives":["coriander"]},{"name":"chili powder","alternatives":["paprika","cayenne"]},{"name":"oregano","alternatives":["thyme"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Dice onion finely. Mince 2 garlic cloves.","Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add 300g ground beef.","Cook 5-6 minutes, breaking up with a spatula, until browned.","Add onion and garlic. Cook 3-4 minutes until onion softens.","Add 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp oregano, salt. Stir and cook 2 minutes.","Add 3 tbsp water and simmer 2-3 minutes until slightly saucy.","Warm tortillas in a dry pan 30 seconds per side. Fill with beef and serve."]}

title: Cheese Quesadilla
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_017","title":"Crispy Cheese Quesadilla","calories":"350-400","cuisine":"Mexican","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Golden crispy tortilla filled with melted cheese.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"tortilla","quantity":"4","unit":"large"},{"name":"cheese","quantity":"200","unit":"g"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt"]},{"name":"paprika","alternatives":["chili powder"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Grate 200g cheese. Lay 2 tortillas flat and spread cheese evenly over each.","Top each with another tortilla to make a sandwich.","Melt 1 tbsp butter in a pan over medium heat.","Place one quesadilla in the pan. Cook 2-3 minutes until the bottom is golden and crispy.","Flip carefully and cook another 2-3 minutes until cheese is fully melted.","Repeat with the second quesadilla. Cut into wedges and serve."]}

title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_018","title":"Spaghetti Aglio e Olio","calories":"380-420","cuisine":"Italian","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Classic Roman pasta with garlic, oil, and a kick of chili.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"pasta","quantity":"250","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"6","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"4","unit":"tbsp"},{"name":"chili flakes","quantity":"1","unit":"tsp"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt"]},{"name":"chili flakes","alternatives":["cayenne","red pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Cook 250g spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water.","Thinly slice 6 garlic cloves while pasta cooks.","Heat 4 tbsp olive oil in a large pan over medium-low heat.","Add garlic and 1 tsp chili flakes. Cook 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until garlic is golden. Do not burn.","Add drained pasta directly to the pan. Toss vigorously, adding pasta water 2 tbsp at a time.","Continue tossing 1-2 minutes until a silky sauce forms. Season with salt and serve."]}

title: Creamy Mashed Potatoes
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_019","title":"Creamy Mashed Potatoes","calories":"300-350","cuisine":"American","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Silky smooth mashed potatoes with butter and milk.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"potato","quantity":"4","unit":"medium"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"3","unit":"tbsp"},{"name":"milk","quantity":"100","unit":"ml"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt"]},{"name":"white pepper","alternatives":["black pepper"]},{"name":"nutmeg","alternatives":["mace"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Peel 4 potatoes and cut into equal 3cm chunks.","Place in a pot of cold salted water. Bring to boil and cook 15-18 minutes until fork-tender.","Drain potatoes and return to the hot pot for 1 minute to steam off excess moisture.","Add 3 tbsp butter and mash until no lumps remain.","Warm 100ml milk and gradually add while mashing until desired consistency.","Season with salt, white pepper, and a pinch of nutmeg. Serve immediately."]}

title: Greek Salad
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_020","title":"Classic Greek Salad","calories":"200-250","cuisine":"Greek","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A refreshing Mediterranean salad with crisp vegetables.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"tomato","quantity":"2","unit":"large"},{"name":"cucumber","quantity":"1","unit":"medium"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"small"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"3","unit":"tbsp"}],"spices":[{"name":"oregano","alternatives":["thyme","basil"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Cut 2 tomatoes into wedges. Slice cucumber into half-moons. Thinly slice onion into rings.","Combine all vegetables in a large bowl.","Drizzle with 3 tbsp olive oil. Add 1 tsp dried oregano, salt and pepper.","Toss gently to combine. Let sit 5 minutes for flavors to meld.","Serve at room temperature."]}

title: French Toast
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_021","title":"Classic French Toast","calories":"350-400","cuisine":"French","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Golden crispy French toast with a custardy center.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"bread","quantity":"4","unit":"thick slices"},{"name":"egg","quantity":"3","unit":"pcs"},{"name":"milk","quantity":"80","unit":"ml"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp"}],"spices":[{"name":"cinnamon","alternatives":["nutmeg","cardamom"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Whisk 3 eggs, 80ml milk, 1/2 tsp cinnamon, and pinch of salt in a shallow dish.","Dip each bread slice into the egg mixture, letting it soak 15 seconds per side.","Melt 1 tbsp butter in a pan over medium heat.","Cook 2 slices for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.","Add remaining butter and cook the other 2 slices.","Serve with honey, maple syrup, or fresh fruit."]}

title: Peanut Butter Sandwich
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_022","title":"Peanut Butter Sandwich","calories":"350-400","cuisine":"American","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A satisfying peanut butter sandwich, simple and delicious.","servings":1,"ingredients":[{"name":"bread","quantity":"2","unit":"slices"},{"name":"peanut butter","quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp"}],"spices":[],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Toast 2 slices of bread to your preferred level of crispness.","Spread 1 tablespoon of peanut butter evenly on each slice.","Press the two slices together gently.","Cut diagonally and serve."]}

title: Scrambled Eggs on Toast
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_023","title":"Scrambled Eggs on Toast","calories":"280-320","cuisine":"American","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Soft creamy scrambled eggs on golden buttered toast.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"egg","quantity":"4","unit":"pcs"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp"},{"name":"bread","quantity":"2","unit":"slices"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Beat 4 eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.","Melt 1 tbsp butter in a non-stick pan over low heat.","Pour in eggs. Stir slowly with a spatula, pushing curds from edges to center.","Cook 3-4 minutes until soft curds form. Remove from heat while still slightly wet.","Toast bread and spread with remaining butter.","Spoon scrambled eggs onto toast. Season and serve."]}

title: Chicken Caesar Wrap
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_024","title":"Chicken Caesar Wrap","calories":"400-450","cuisine":"American","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Grilled chicken with crisp lettuce wrapped in a tortilla.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"chicken","quantity":"250","unit":"g"},{"name":"lettuce","quantity":"1","unit":"head"},{"name":"tortilla","quantity":"2","unit":"large"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"2","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper"]},{"name":"oregano","alternatives":["thyme"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Season 250g chicken breast with salt, pepper, oregano, and minced garlic.","Heat a grill pan over medium-high heat. Cook chicken 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through.","Let chicken rest 3 minutes, then slice into thin strips.","Shred lettuce leaves. Warm tortillas in a dry pan 30 seconds per side.","Lay tortilla flat. Add lettuce and chicken strips down the center.","Roll tightly, tucking in the bottom. Cut in half and serve."]}

title: Avocado Toast
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_025","title":"Avocado Toast","calories":"250-300","cuisine":"American","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Creamy mashed avocado on crispy toast with a squeeze of lemon.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"bread","quantity":"2","unit":"thick slices"},{"name":"avocado","quantity":"1","unit":"large"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"small"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper"]},{"name":"chili flakes","alternatives":["paprika"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Toast 2 thick slices of bread until golden and crispy.","Cut avocado in half, remove pit. Scoop flesh into a bowl.","Mash with a fork, leaving some chunks. Add juice of half a lemon, salt and pepper.","Spread generously on toast. Sprinkle with chili flakes.","Serve immediately."]}

title: Pasta Carbonara
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_026","title":"Pasta Carbonara","calories":"450-500","cuisine":"Italian","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A creamy egg-based pasta sauce that is rich and satisfying.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"pasta","quantity":"250","unit":"g"},{"name":"egg","quantity":"3","unit":"pcs"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"2","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp"}],"spices":[{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Cook 250g spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water.","Whisk 3 eggs with generous black pepper and salt in a bowl.","Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add 2 sliced garlic cloves, cook 2 minutes until golden.","Remove pan from heat. Add drained hot pasta directly to the pan.","Immediately pour egg mixture over hot pasta. Toss quickly and vigorously for 1-2 minutes.","Add pasta water 1 tbsp at a time until a creamy sauce forms. The residual heat cooks the eggs gently.","Serve immediately with extra black pepper on top."]}

title: Vegetable Soup
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_027","title":"Hearty Vegetable Soup","calories":"200-250","cuisine":"American","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A warming soup loaded with tender vegetables.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"potato","quantity":"2","unit":"medium"},{"name":"carrot","quantity":"2","unit":"medium"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"medium"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"3","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"thyme","alternatives":["rosemary","oregano"]},{"name":"bay leaf","alternatives":["thyme"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Dice potatoes and carrots into 1.5cm cubes. Dice onion. Mince 3 garlic cloves.","Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a pot over medium heat.","Add onion, cook 3-4 minutes. Add garlic, cook 30 seconds.","Add potatoes and carrots. Stir 1 minute.","Add 800ml water, 1/2 tsp thyme, 1 bay leaf, salt and pepper.","Bring to boil, reduce to simmer. Cook 20-25 minutes until vegetables are tender.","Remove bay leaf. Adjust seasoning and serve hot."]}

title: Tuna Sandwich
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_028","title":"Classic Tuna Sandwich","calories":"300-350","cuisine":"American","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A hearty tuna sandwich with a tangy lemon twist.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"bread","quantity":"4","unit":"slices"},{"name":"tuna","quantity":"200","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"small"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"small"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Drain 200g canned tuna and place in a bowl.","Finely dice the small onion. Add to tuna.","Squeeze juice of half a lemon over the mixture. Season with salt and pepper.","Mix well with a fork, breaking up tuna into flakes.","Toast 4 slices of bread. Divide tuna mixture between 2 slices.","Top with remaining bread slices. Cut diagonally and serve."]}

title: Garlic Shrimp

recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_044","title":"Pan-Seared Steak with Garlic Butter","calories":"500-550","cuisine":"American","difficulty":"Hard","description":"Perfectly seared steak basted in aromatic garlic herb butter.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"beef","quantity":"2","unit":"steaks"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"3","unit":"tbsp"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"4","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Remove steaks from fridge 30 minutes before cooking.
